description: Synthetic development/holdout test of down-weighting duplicate members from the same species while building profile HMM emissions.
reason: Species balancing preserved top-1 family identification but made the strict weakest-member threshold substantially harder to clear. Strict true-query recovery fell from 13-14 to 2-4, median threshold margins decreased by 55-73.5 score units, and unrelated-negative maximum scores increased slightly. The candidate therefore failed the independent gate and was removed before an OrthoBench run.

configuration.perturbation: Duplicate one species in every family before profile construction

label_policy: Uses generated family and species labels only; no OrthoBench, QfO, Three Kingdoms, or competing-tool labels or scores are read during inference or selection.
